versos.grego: Ὡς οὖν ἔγνω ὁ Κύριος ὅτι ἤκουσαν οἱ Φαρισαῖοι ὅτι Ἰησοῦς πλείονας μαθητὰς ποιεῖ καὶ βαπτίζει ἢ Ἰωάνης,

controles.web: Therefore when the Lord knew that the Pharisees had heard that Jesus was making and baptizing more disciples than John
controles.kjv: When therefore the Lord knew how the Pharisees had heard that Jesus made and baptized more disciples than John,
controles.livre: Quando, pois, o Senhor entendeu que os fariseus ouviram que Jesus fazia e batizava mais discípulos que João

versos.grego: —καίτοιγε Ἰησοῦς αὐτὸς οὐκ ἐβάπτιζεν ἀλλ’ οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ,—

controles.web: (although Jesus himself didn’t baptize, but his disciples),
controles.kjv: (Though Jesus himself baptized not, but his disciples,)
controles.livre: (ainda que Jesus mesmo não batizava, mas sim seus discípulos),

versos.grego: ἀφῆκεν τὴν Ἰουδαίαν καὶ ἀπῆλθεν πάλιν εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν.

controles.web: he left Judea, and departed into Galilee.
controles.kjv: He left Judea, and departed again into Galilee.
controles.livre: Ele deixou a Judeia, e foi outra vez para a Galileia.

versos.grego: Ἔδει δὲ αὐτὸν διέρχεσθαι διὰ τῆς Σαμαρίας.

controles.web: He needed to pass through Samaria.
controles.kjv: And he must needs go through Samaria.
controles.livre: E foi necessário passar por Samaria.

versos.grego: ἔρχεται οὖν εἰς πόλιν τῆς Σαμαρίας λεγομένην Συχὰρ, πλησίον τοῦ χωρίου ὃ ἔδωκεν Ἰακὼβ Ἰωσὴφ τῷ υἱῷ αὐτοῦ·

controles.web: So he came to a city of Samaria, called Sychar, near the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son, Joseph.
controles.kjv: Then cometh he to a city of Samaria, which is called Sychar, near to the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.
controles.livre: Veio pois a uma cidade de Samaria, chamada Sicar, junto à propriedade que Jacó deu a seu filho José.

versos.grego: ἦν δὲ ἐκεῖ πηγὴ τοῦ Ἰακώβ. ὁ οὖν Ἰησοῦς κεκοπιακὼς ἐκ τῆς ὁδοιπορίας ἐκαθέζετο οὕτως ἐπὶ τῇ πηγῇ· ὥρα ἦν ὡς ἕκτη.

controles.web: Jacob’s well was there. Jesus therefore, being tired from his journey, sat down by the well. It was about the sixth hour.
controles.kjv: Now Jacob’s well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied with his journey, sat thus on the well: and it was about the sixth hour.
controles.livre: E ali estava a fonte de Jacó. Então Jesus, cansado do caminho, sentou-se assim junto à fonte; era isto quase à hora sexta.

versos.grego: ἔρχεται γυνὴ ἐκ τῆς Σαμαρίας ἀντλῆσαι ὕδωρ. λέγει αὐτῇ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Δός μοι πεῖν.

controles.web: A woman of Samaria came to draw water. Jesus said to her, “Give me a drink.”
controles.kjv: There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water: Jesus saith unto her, Give me to drink.
controles.livre: Veio uma mulher de Samaria para tirar água; Disse-lhe Jesus: Dá-me de beber.

versos.grego: οἱ γὰρ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ ἀπεληλύθεισαν εἰς τὴν πόλιν, ἵνα τροφὰς ἀγοράσωσιν.

controles.web: For his disciples had gone away into the city to buy food.
controles.kjv: (For his disciples were gone away unto the city to buy meat.)
controles.livre: (Porque seus discípulos haviam ido à cidade para a comprar de comer).

versos.grego: λέγει οὖν αὐτῷ ἡ γυνὴ ἡ Σαμαρεῖτις Πῶς σὺ Ἰουδαῖος ὢν παρ’ ἐμοῦ πεῖν αἰτεῖς γυναικὸς Σαμαρείτιδος οὔσης; οὐ γὰρ συνχρῶνται Ἰουδαῖοι Σαμαρείταις.

controles.web: The Samaritan woman therefore said to him, “How is it that you, being a Jew, ask for a drink from me, a Samaritan woman?” (For Jews have no dealings with Samaritans.)
controles.kjv: Then saith the woman of Samaria unto him, How is it that thou, being a Jew, askest drink of me, which am a woman of Samaria? for the Jews have no dealings with the Samaritans.
controles.livre: Disse-lhe pois a mulher samaritana: Como, sendo tu judeu, me pedes de beber, que sou mulher samaritana? (Porque os judeus não se comunicam com o samaritanos.)

versos.grego: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῇ Εἰ ᾔδεις τὴν δωρεὰν τοῦ Θεοῦ, καὶ τίς ἐστιν ὁ λέγων σοι Δός μοι πεῖν, σὺ ἂν ᾔτησας αὐτὸν καὶ ἔδωκεν ἄν σοι ὕδωρ ζῶν.

controles.web: Jesus answered her, “If you knew the gift of God, and who it is who says to you, ‘Give me a drink,’ you would have asked him, and he would have given you living water.”
controles.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto her, If thou knewest the gift of God, and who it is that saith to thee, Give me to drink; thou wouldest have asked of him, and he would have given thee living water.
controles.livre: Respondeu Jesus, e disse-lhe: Se tu conhecesses o dom de Deus, e quem é o que te diz: Dá-me de beber, tu lhe pedirias, e ele te daria água viva.

versos.grego: λέγει αὐτῷ Κύριε, οὔτε ἄντλημα ἔχεις καὶ τὸ φρέαρ ἐστὶν βαθύ· πόθεν οὖν ἔχεις τὸ ὕδωρ τὸ ζῶν;

controles.web: The woman said to him, “Sir, you have nothing to draw with, and the well is deep. From where then have you that living water?
controles.kjv: The woman saith unto him, Sir, thou hast nothing to draw with, and the well is deep: from whence then hast thou that living water?
controles.livre: Disse a mulher: Senhor, tu não tens com que a tirar, e o poço é fundo; de onde pois tens a água viva?

versos.grego: μὴ σὺ μείζων εἶ τοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν Ἰακώβ, ὃς ἔδωκεν ἡμῖν τὸ φρέαρ, καὶ αὐτὸς ἐξ αὐτοῦ ἔπιεν καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ θρέμματα αὐτοῦ;

controles.web: Are you greater than our father, Jacob, who gave us the well, and drank of it himself, as did his children, and his livestock?”
controles.kjv: Art thou greater than our father Jacob, which gave us the well, and drank thereof himself, and his children, and his cattle?
controles.livre: És tu maior que nosso pai Jacó, que nos deu o poço? E ele mesmo dele bebeu, e seus filhos, e seu gado?

versos.grego: ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῇ Πᾶς ὁ πίνων ἐκ τοῦ ὕδατος τούτου διψήσει πάλιν·

controles.web: Jesus answered her, “Everyone who drinks of this water will thirst again,
controles.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto her, Whosoever drinketh of this water shall thirst again:
controles.livre: Jesus respondeu, e disse-lhe: Todo aquele que beber desta água voltará a ter sede;

versos.grego: ὃς δ’ ἂν πίῃ ἐκ τοῦ ὕδατος οὗ ἐγὼ δώσω αὐτῷ, οὐ μὴ διψήσει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα, ἀλλὰ τὸ ὕδωρ ὃ δώσω αὐτῷ γενήσεται ἐν αὐτῷ πηγὴ ὕδατος ἁλλομένου εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον.

controles.web: but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never thirst again; but the water that I will give him will become in him a well of water springing up to eternal life.”
controles.kjv: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.
controles.livre: Porém aquele que beber da água que eu lhe der, para sempre não terá sede, mas a água que eu lhe der se fará nele fonte de água, que salte para vida eterna.

versos.grego: λέγει πρὸς αὐτὸν ἡ γυνή Κύριε, δός μοι τοῦτο τὸ ὕδωρ, ἵνα μὴ διψῶ μηδὲ διέρχωμαι ἐνθάδε ἀντλεῖν.

controles.web: The woman said to him, “Sir, give me this water, so that I don’t get thirsty, neither come all the way here to draw.”
controles.kjv: The woman saith unto him, Sir, give me this water, that I thirst not, neither come hither to draw.
controles.livre: Disse-lhe a mulher: Senhor, dá-me desta água, para que eu não tenha mais sede, nem venha aqui para tirar.

versos.grego: λέγει αὐτῇ Ὕπαγε φώνησον τὸν ἄνδρα σου καὶ ἐλθὲ ἐνθάδε.

controles.web: Jesus said to her, “Go, call your husband, and come here.”
controles.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Go, call thy husband, and come hither.
controles.livre: Disse-lhe Jesus: Vai, chama a teu marido, e vem cá.

versos.grego: ἀπεκρίθη ἡ γυνὴ καὶ εἶπεν Οὐκ ἔχω ἄνδρα. λέγει αὐτῇ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Καλῶς εἶπες ὅτι Ἄνδρα οὐκ ἔχω·

controles.web: The woman answered, “I have no husband.”   Jesus said to her, “You said well, ‘I have no husband,’
controles.kjv: The woman answered and said, I have no husband. Jesus said unto her, Thou hast well said, I have no husband:
controles.livre: A mulher respondeu, e disse: Não tenho marido. Disse-lhe Jesus: Bem disseste: Marido não tenho.

versos.grego: πέντε γὰρ ἄνδρας ἔσχες, καὶ νῦν ὃν ἔχεις οὐκ ἔστιν σου ἀνήρ· τοῦτο ἀληθὲς εἴρηκας.

controles.web: for you have had five husbands; and he whom you now have is not your husband. This you have said truly.”
controles.kjv: For thou hast had five husbands; and he whom thou now hast is not thy husband: in that saidst thou truly.
controles.livre: Porque cinco maridos tiveste, e o que agora tens não é teu marido; isto com verdade disseste.

versos.grego: λέγει αὐτῷ ἡ γυνή Κύριε, θεωρῶ ὅτι προφήτης εἶ σύ.

controles.web: The woman said to him, “Sir, I perceive that you are a prophet.
controles.kjv: The woman saith unto him, Sir, I perceive that thou art a prophet.
controles.livre: Disse-lhe a mulher: Senhor, vejo que és profeta.

versos.grego: οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν ἐν τῷ ὄρει τούτῳ προσεκύνησαν· καὶ ὑμεῖς λέγετε ὅτι ἐν Ἱεροσολύμοις ἐστὶν ὁ τόπος ὅπου προσκυνεῖν δεῖ.

controles.web: Our fathers worshiped in this mountain, and you Jews say that in Jerusalem is the place where people ought to worship.”
controles.kjv: Our fathers worshipped in this mountain; and ye say, that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship.
controles.livre: Nossos pais adoraram neste monte, e vós dizeis que em Jerusalém é o lugar onde se deve adorar.

versos.grego: λέγει αὐτῇ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Πίστευέ μοι, γύναι, ὅτι ἔρχεται ὥρα ὅτε οὔτε ἐν τῷ ὄρει τούτῳ οὔτε ἐν Ἱεροσολύμοις προσκυνήσετε τῷ Πατρί.

controles.web: Jesus said to her, “Woman, believe me, the hour comes, when neither in this mountain, nor in Jerusalem, will you worship the Father.
controles.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, believe me, the hour cometh, when ye shall neither in this mountain, nor yet at Jerusalem, worship the Father.
controles.livre: Disse-lhe Jesus: Mulher, crê em mim, que a hora vem, quando nem neste monte, nem em Jerusalém, adorareis ao Pai.

versos.grego: ὑμεῖς προσκυνεῖτε ὃ οὐκ οἴδατε, ἡμεῖς προσκυνοῦμεν ὃ οἴδαμεν, ὅτι ἡ σωτηρία ἐκ τῶν Ἰουδαίων ἐστίν·

controles.web: You worship that which you don’t know. We worship that which we know; for salvation is from the Jews.
controles.kjv: Ye worship ye know not what: we know what we worship: for salvation is of the Jews.
controles.livre: Vós adorais o que não sabeis; nós adoramos o que sabemos, porque a salvação vem dos judeus.

versos.grego: ἀλλὰ ἔρχεται ὥρα καὶ νῦν ἐστιν, ὅτε οἱ ἀληθινοὶ προσκυνηταὶ προσκυνήσουσιν τῷ Πατρὶ ἐν πνεύματι καὶ ἀληθείᾳ· καὶ γὰρ ὁ Πατὴρ τοιούτους ζητεῖ τοὺς προσκυνοῦντας αὐτόν·

controles.web: But the hour comes, and now is, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father seeks such to be his worshipers.
controles.kjv: But the hour cometh, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth: for the Father seeketh such to worship him.
controles.livre: Porém a hora vem, e agora é, quando os verdadeiros adoradores adorarão ao Pai em espírito e em verdade; porque também o Pai busca a tais que o adorem.

versos.grego: Πνεῦμα ὁ Θεός, καὶ τοὺς προσκυνοῦντας ἐν πνεύματι καὶ ἀληθείᾳ δεῖ προσκυνεῖν.

controles.web: God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.”
controles.kjv: God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.
controles.livre: Deus é Espírito, e os que o adoram devem adorá -lo em espírito e em verdade.

versos.grego: λέγει αὐτῷ ἡ γυνή Οἶδα ὅτι Μεσσίας ἔρχεται, ὁ λεγόμενος Χριστός· ὅταν ἔλθῃ ἐκεῖνος, ἀναγγελεῖ ἡμῖν ἅπαντα.

controles.web: The woman said to him, “I know that Messiah comes, he who is called Christ. When he has come, he will declare to us all things.”
controles.kjv: The woman saith unto him, I know that Messias cometh, which is called Christ: when he is come, he will tell us all things.
controles.livre: Disse-lhe a mulher: Eu sei que o Messias vem (que se chama o Cristo); quando ele vier, todas as coisas nos anunciará.

versos.grego: λέγει αὐτῇ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἐγώ εἰμι, ὁ λαλῶν σοι.

controles.web: Jesus said to her, “I am he, the one who speaks to you.”
controles.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, I that speak unto thee am he.
controles.livre: Disse-lhe Jesus: Eu sou o que contigo falo.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἐπὶ τούτῳ ἦλθαν οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐθαύμαζον ὅτι μετὰ γυναικὸς ἐλάλει· οὐδεὶς μέντοι εἶπεν Τί ζητεῖς ἢ τί λαλεῖς μετ’ αὐτῆς;

controles.web: At this, his disciples came. They marveled that he was speaking with a woman; yet no one said, “What are you looking for?” or, “Why do you speak with her?”
controles.kjv: And upon this came his disciples, and marvelled that he talked with the woman: yet no man said, What seekest thou? or, Why talkest thou with her?
controles.livre: E nisto vieram seus discípulos; e maravilharam-se de que falasse com uma mulher; mas ninguém lhe disse: Que perguntas? ou, O que falas com ela?

versos.grego: ἀφῆκεν οὖν τὴν ὑδρίαν αὐτῆς ἡ γυνὴ καὶ ἀπῆλθεν εἰς τὴν πόλιν, καὶ λέγει τοῖς ἀνθρώποις

controles.web: So the woman left her water pot, and went away into the city, and said to the people,
controles.kjv: The woman then left her waterpot, and went her way into the city, and saith to the men,
controles.livre: Deixou, pois, a mulher seu vaso de água, e foi à cidade, e disse ao povo:

versos.grego: Δεῦτε ἴδετε ἄνθρωπον ὃς εἶπέν μοι πάντα ἃ ἐποίησα· μήτι οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ Χριστός;

controles.web: “Come, see a man who told me everything that I did. Can this be the Christ?”
controles.kjv: Come, see a man, which told me all things that ever I did: is not this the Christ?
controles.livre: Vinde, vede um homem que me disse tudo quanto tenho feito; por acaso não é este o Cristo?

versos.grego: ἐξῆλθον ἐκ τῆς πόλεως καὶ ἤρχοντο πρὸς αὐτόν.

controles.web: They went out of the city, and were coming to him.
controles.kjv: Then they went out of the city, and came unto him.
controles.livre: Saíram, pois, da cidade, e vieram a ele.

versos.grego: Ἐν τῷ μεταξὺ ἠρώτων αὐτὸν οἱ μαθηταὶ λέγοντες Ῥαββεί, φάγε.

controles.web: In the meanwhile, the disciples urged him, saying, “Rabbi, eat.”
controles.kjv: In the mean while his disciples prayed him, saying, Master, eat.
controles.livre: E enquanto isso, os discípulos lhe pediam, dizendo: Rabi, come.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ἐγὼ βρῶσιν ἔχω φαγεῖν ἣν ὑμεῖς οὐκ οἴδατε.

controles.web: But he said to them, “I have food to eat that you don’t know about.”
controles.kjv: But he said unto them, I have meat to eat that ye know not of.
controles.livre: Porém ele lhes disse: Uma comida tenho que comer, que vós não sabeis.

versos.grego: ἔλεγον οὖν οἱ μαθηταὶ πρὸς ἀλλήλους Μή τις ἤνεγκεν αὐτῷ φαγεῖν;

controles.web: The disciples therefore said one to another, “Has anyone brought him something to eat?”
controles.kjv: Therefore said the disciples one to another, Hath any man brought him ought to eat?
controles.livre: Diziam, pois, os discípulos uns aos outros: Por acaso alguém lhe trouxe de comer?

versos.grego: λέγει αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἐμὸν βρῶμά ἐστιν ἵνα ποιῶ τὸ θέλημα τοῦ πέμψαντός με καὶ τελειώσω αὐτοῦ τὸ ἔργον.

controles.web: Jesus said to them, “My food is to do the will of him who sent me, and to accomplish his work.
controles.kjv: Jesus saith unto them, My meat is to do the will of him that sent me, and to finish his work.
controles.livre: Disse-lhes Jesus: Minha comida é fazer a vontade daquele que me enviou, e cumprir sua obra.

versos.grego: οὐχ ὑμεῖς λέγετε ὅτι Ἔτι τετράμηνός ἐστιν καὶ ὁ θερισμὸς ἔρχεται; ἰδοὺ λέγω ὑμῖν, ἐπάρατε τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς ὑμῶν καὶ θεάσασθε τὰς χώρας, ὅτι λευκαί εἰσιν πρὸς θερισμόν. ἤδη

controles.web: Don’t you say, ‘There are yet four months until the harvest?’ Behold, I tell you, lift up your eyes, and look at the fields, that they are white for harvest already.
controles.kjv: Say not ye, There are yet four months, and then cometh harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are white already to harvest.
controles.livre: Não dizeis vós, que ainda há quatro meses até que venha a ceifa? Eis que vos digo: Levantai vossos olhos, e vede as terras; porque já estão brancas para a ceifa.

versos.grego: ὁ θερίζων μισθὸν λαμβάνει καὶ συνάγει καρπὸν εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον, ἵνα ὁ σπείρων ὁμοῦ χαίρῃ καὶ ὁ θερίζων.

controles.web: He who reaps receives wages, and gathers fruit to eternal life; that both he who sows and he who reaps may rejoice together.
controles.kjv: And he that reapeth receiveth wages, and gathereth fruit unto life eternal: that both he that soweth and he that reapeth may rejoice together.
controles.livre: E o que ceifa, recebe recompensa, e junta fruto para vida eterna; para que ambos se alegrem, tanto o que semeia, quanto o que ceifa.

versos.grego: ἐν γὰρ τούτῳ ὁ λόγος ἐστὶν ἀληθινὸς ὅτι ἄλλος ἐστὶν ὁ σπείρων καὶ ἄλλος ὁ θερίζων.

controles.web: For in this the saying is true, ‘One sows, and another reaps.’
controles.kjv: And herein is that saying true, One soweth, and another reapeth.
controles.livre: Porque nisto é verdadeiro o ditado, que: Um é o que semeia, e outro o que ceifa.

versos.grego: ἐγὼ ἀπέστειλα ὑμᾶς θερίζειν ὃ οὐχ ὑμεῖς κεκοπιάκατε· ἄλλοι κεκοπιάκασιν, καὶ ὑμεῖς εἰς τὸν κόπον αὐτῶν εἰσεληλύθατε.

controles.web: I sent you to reap that for which you haven’t labored. Others have labored, and you have entered into their labor.”
controles.kjv: I sent you to reap that whereon ye bestowed no labour: other men laboured, and ye are entered into their labours.
controles.livre: Eu vos enviei para ceifar onde vós não trabalhastes; outros trabalharam, e vós entrastes no trabalho deles.

versos.grego: Ἐκ δὲ τῆς πόλεως ἐκείνης πολλοὶ ἐπίστευσαν εἰς αὐτὸν τῶν Σαμαρειτῶν διὰ τὸν λόγον τῆς γυναικὸς μαρτυρούσης ὅτι Εἶπέν μοι πάντα ἃ ἐποίησα.

controles.web: From that city many of the Samaritans believed in him because of the word of the woman, who testified, “He told me everything that I did.”
controles.kjv: And many of the Samaritans of that city believed on him for the saying of the woman, which testified, He told me all that ever I did.
controles.livre: E muitos dos samaritanos daquela cidade creram nele pela palavra da mulher, que testemunhava, dizendo: Ele me disse tudo quanto eu tenho feito.

versos.grego: ὡς οὖν ἦλθον πρὸς αὐτὸν οἱ Σαμαρεῖται, ἠρώτων αὐτὸν μεῖναι παρ’ αὐτοῖς· καὶ ἔμεινεν ἐκεῖ δύο ἡμέρας.

controles.web: So when the Samaritans came to him, they begged him to stay with them. He stayed there two days.
controles.kjv: So when the Samaritans were come unto him, they besought him that he would tarry with them: and he abode there two days.
controles.livre: Vindo pois os samaritanos a ele, suplicaram-lhe que ficasse com eles; e ele ficou ali dois dias.

versos.grego: καὶ πολλῷ πλείους ἐπίστευσαν διὰ τὸν λόγον αὐτοῦ,

controles.web: Many more believed because of his word.
controles.kjv: And many more believed because of his own word;
controles.livre: E creram ainda muitos mais pela palavra dele.

versos.grego: τῇ τε γυναικὶ ἔλεγον ὅτι Οὐκέτι διὰ τὴν σὴν λαλιὰν πιστεύομεν· αὐτοὶ γὰρ ἀκηκόαμεν, καὶ οἴδαμεν ὅτι οὗτός ἐστιν ἀληθῶς ὁ Σωτὴρ τοῦ κόσμου.

controles.web: They said to the woman, “Now we believe, not because of your speaking; for we have heard for ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Savior of the world.”
controles.kjv: And said unto the woman, Now we believe, not because of thy saying: for we have heard him ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Saviour of the world.
controles.livre: E diziam à mulher: Já não cremos por teu dito; porque nós mesmos temos o ouvido, e sabemos que verdadeiramente este é o Cristo, o Salvador do mundo.

versos.grego: Μετὰ δὲ τὰς δύο ἡμέρας ἐξῆλθεν ἐκεῖθεν εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν.

controles.web: After the two days he went out from there and went into Galilee.
controles.kjv: Now after two days he departed thence, and went into Galilee.
controles.livre: E depois de dois dias partiu dali, e foi-se para a Galileia.

versos.grego: αὐτὸς γὰρ Ἰησοῦς ἐμαρτύρησεν ὅτι προφήτης ἐν τῇ ἰδίᾳ πατρίδι τιμὴν οὐκ ἔχει.

controles.web: For Jesus himself testified that a prophet has no honor in his own country.
controles.kjv: For Jesus himself testified, that a prophet hath no honour in his own country.
controles.livre: Porque o mesmo Jesus testemunhou que não tem o Profeta honra em sua própria terra.

versos.grego: ὅτε οὖν ἦλθεν εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν, ἐδέξαντο αὐτὸν οἱ Γαλιλαῖοι, πάντα ἑωρακότες ὅσα ἐποίησεν ἐν Ἱεροσολύμοις ἐν τῇ ἑορτῇ· καὶ αὐτοὶ γὰρ ἦλθον εἰς τὴν ἑορτήν.

controles.web: So when he came into Galilee, the Galileans received him, having seen all the things that he did in Jerusalem at the feast, for they also went to the feast.
controles.kjv: Then when he was come into Galilee, the Galileans received him, having seen all the things that he did at Jerusalem at the feast: for they also went unto the feast.
controles.livre: Vindo pois para a Galileia, os Galileus o receberam, havendo visto todas as coisas que fizera em Jerusalém no dia da festa, porque também eles foram ao dia da festa.

versos.grego: Ἦλθεν οὖν πάλιν εἰς τὴν Κανὰ τῆς Γαλιλαίας, ὅπου ἐποίησεν τὸ ὕδωρ οἶνον. Καὶ ἦν τις βασιλικὸς οὗ ὁ υἱὸς ἠσθένει ἐν Καφαρναούμ·

controles.web: Jesus came therefore again to Cana of Galilee, where he made the water into wine. There was a certain nobleman whose son was sick at Capernaum.
controles.kjv: So Jesus came again into Cana of Galilee, where he made the water wine. And there was a certain nobleman, whose son was sick at Capernaum.
controles.livre: Veio pois Jesus outra vez a Caná da Galileia, onde da água fizera vinho. E estava ali um nobre, cujo filho estava enfermo em Cafarnaum.

versos.grego: οὗτος ἀκούσας ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ἥκει ἐκ τῆς Ἰουδαίας εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν, ἀπῆλθεν πρὸς αὐτὸν καὶ ἠρώτα ἵνα καταβῇ καὶ ἰάσηται αὐτοῦ τὸν υἱόν· ἤμελλεν γὰρ ἀποθνήσκειν.

controles.web: When he heard that Jesus had come out of Judea into Galilee, he went to him, and begged him that he would come down and heal his son, for he was at the point of death.
controles.kjv: When he heard that Jesus was come out of Judea into Galilee, he went unto him, and besought him that he would come down, and heal his son: for he was at the point of death.
controles.livre: Ouvindo este que Jesus vinha da Judeia para a Galileia, foi ter com ele, e suplicava-lhe que descesse, e curasse a seu filho, porque já estava à morte.

versos.grego: εἶπεν οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς πρὸς αὐτόν Ἐὰν μὴ σημεῖα καὶ τέρατα ἴδητε, οὐ μὴ πιστεύσητε.

controles.web: Jesus therefore said to him, “Unless you see signs and wonders, you will in no way believe.”
controles.kjv: Then said Jesus unto him, Except ye see signs and wonders, ye will not believe.
controles.livre: Disse-lhe pois Jesus: Se não virdes sinais e milagres não crereis.

versos.grego: λέγει πρὸς αὐτὸν ὁ βασιλικός Κύριε, κατάβηθι πρὶν ἀποθανεῖν τὸ παιδίον μου.

controles.web: The nobleman said to him, “Sir, come down before my child dies.”
controles.kjv: The nobleman saith unto him, Sir, come down ere my child die.
controles.livre: O nobre lhe disse: Senhor, desce, antes que meu filho morra.

versos.grego: λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Πορεύου· ὁ υἱός σου ζῇ. ἐπίστευσεν ὁ ἄνθρωπος τῷ λόγῳ ὃν εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς, καὶ ἐπορεύετο.

controles.web: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your son lives.” The man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him, and he went his way.
controles.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, Go thy way; thy son liveth. And the man believed the word that Jesus had spoken unto him, and he went his way.
controles.livre: Disse-lhe Jesus: Vai, teu filho vive. E o homem creu na palavra que Jesus lhe disse, e se foi.

versos.grego: ἤδη δὲ αὐτοῦ καταβαίνοντος οἱ δοῦλοι ὑπήντησαν αὐτῷ λέγοντες ὅτι ὁ παῖς αὐτοῦ ζῇ.

controles.web: As he was now going down, his servants met him and reported, saying “Your child lives!”
controles.kjv: And as he was now going down, his servants met him, and told him, saying, Thy son liveth.
controles.livre: E estando ele já descendo, seus servos lhe saíram ao encontro, e lhe anunciaram, dizendo: Teu filho vive.

versos.grego: ἐπύθετο οὖν τὴν ὥραν παρ’ αὐτῶν ἐν ᾗ κομψότερον ἔσχεν· εἶπαν οὖν αὐτῷ ὅτι Ἐχθὲς ὥραν ἑβδόμην ἀφῆκεν αὐτὸν ὁ πυρετός.

controles.web: So he inquired of them the hour when he began to get better. They said therefore to him, “Yesterday at the seventh hour, the fever left him.”
controles.kjv: Then enquired he of them the hour when he began to amend. And they said unto him, Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.
controles.livre: Perguntou-lhes pois, a que hora se achara melhor; e disseram-lhe: Ontem às sete horas a febre o deixou.

versos.grego: ἔγνω οὖν ὁ πατὴρ ὅτι ἐκείνῃ τῇ ὥρᾳ ἐν ᾗ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ὁ υἱός σου ζῇ· καὶ ἐπίστευσεν αὐτὸς καὶ ἡ οἰκία αὐτοῦ ὅλη.

controles.web: So the father knew that it was at that hour in which Jesus said to him, “Your son lives.” He believed, as did his whole house.
controles.kjv: So the father knew that it was at the same hour, in the which Jesus said unto him, Thy son liveth: and himself believed, and his whole house.
controles.livre: Entendeu pois o pai, que aquela era a mesma hora em que Jesus lhe disse: Teu filho vive. E creu nele, e toda sua casa.

versos.grego: Τοῦτο δὲ πάλιν δεύτερον σημεῖον ἐποίησεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐλθὼν ἐκ τῆς Ἰουδαίας εἰς τὴν Γαλιλαίαν.

controles.web: This is again the second sign that Jesus did, having come out of Judea into Galilee.
controles.kjv: This is again the second miracle that Jesus did, when he was come out of Judea into Galilee.
controles.livre: Este segundo sinal Jesus voltou a fazer, quando ele veio d a Judeia a Galileia.
